Our mission is to change the way the world feels about Monday

Brightlane is a community of people who want to make a life and not only a living, and who believe that work goes better when it is shared with others.

We create places where a person can walk in as an individual and become part of something larger than themselves, from the first coffee of the morning.

We began in 2012 with a single floor in a converted warehouse, and today members work from our buildings in cities across three continents.

Every space is designed to bring people together, with shared kitchens, open stairways and rooms that can be booked in a few seconds.

We believe that when people feel they belong, they do the best work of their careers and help the people around them do the same.

What we stand for

  • Be part of something greater than yourself, and bring others along with you.
  • Be entrepreneurial: treat every problem in the building as your own to solve.
  • Be authentic, because members can tell when a welcome is not meant.
  • Be grateful for the people who keep the doors open and the lights on.

Join us at a space near you and see what a working week can feel like when you are glad to arrive.

Members tell us that the thing they value most is not the desk but the people at the next one.
